verdict.score_rationale: The board is readable with effort, matching the 6–6.5 anchor because its staged hierarchy and branching are recoverable, but small text and several long cross-region routes prevent fluent arm’s-length reading.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and label chips have generous clearance, though the very large canvas makes node and edge-label text—including “changed,” “completed version,” and “published versions only”—small at arm’s length.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: The four numbered horizontal regions clearly separate ingestion, publication, query, and model-change functions, with parallel stores and searches grouped coherently.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Local arrows are clean and labeled, but the teal completed-version route, blue published-version route, and magenta feedback route make long perimeter detours across or around region boundaries that require sustained tracing.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Main flows, decisions, retries, failures, and rollback paths are visually decomposed, but the sparse yet extremely wide layout and distant feedback connections weaken at-a-glance recovery of the overall topology.
